title: Ada and the Well
author: Freya Winterbourne
blurb: Gideon Quintana, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the family out ahead of the count before the last resident signs the papers.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
